title: Lion
tagline: LionClub is a sharing-video app where all your activities are on-chain.
description:
LionClub uses the advantages of decentralizations to allow all social media users to earn from their activities.

It's easy to join and to view videos publish on IPFS, distributed on Livepeer. Users can subscribe to see/publish more videos every month.

More info on lionclub.app.
how_its_made:
This project use IPFS for decentralization of content, Livepeer to distribute and stream content.
We are using Unlock Protocol to integrate monthly subscriptions easily.
For only $5 per month, users can pay with a credit card or crypto currencies to access and publish more videos every month.
